items.name: api-docs
items.title: API docs
items.description: Interactive API reference at /docs, generated from your OpenAPI document (Scalar).

items.name: audit-log
items.title: Audit log
items.description: Who changed what and when: every create, update and delete with a field-level diff (private fields never recorded). Admin API included.

items.name: jobs
items.title: Background jobs
items.description: Background jobs and cron on MongoDB (no Redis): retries with backoff, schedules, event triggers, admin API and a devtools panel.

items.name: mail-resend
items.title: Email via Resend
items.description: Deliver emails (password resets, notifications) through the Resend HTTP API. No SDK, just fetch.

items.name: mail-smtp
items.title: Email via SMTP
items.description: Deliver emails through any SMTP server (SES, Postmark, Mailgun, your own) with Nodemailer.

items.name: mcp-server
items.title: MCP server
items.description: Expose your resources to AI agents as Model Context Protocol tools (Streamable HTTP at /mcp). Every call goes through the same policies, validation and serialization as the REST API.

items.name: rate-limit-mongo
items.title: Shared rate limits (MongoDB)
items.description: Store rate limit counters in MongoDB so limits hold across every instance of your API.

items.name: realtime-sse
items.title: Realtime (SSE)
items.description: Live resource changes over Server-Sent Events, filtered per subscriber with the same policies, scopes and field visibility as the REST API.

items.name: soft-delete
items.title: Soft delete
items.description: Opt-in soft delete per resource: DELETE marks records deleted, queries hide them, admins can list and restore them.

items.name: storage-local
items.title: Local file storage
items.description: File uploads to local disk: a 'file' resource, type and size allowlists, magic-byte checks and safe downloads.

items.name: storage-s3
items.title: S3 file storage
items.description: Direct-to-S3 uploads with presigned URLs (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO): a 'file' resource, type and size allowlists, verified completion and private downloads.
